b1-36-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Don't Give Up Now
b1-36-01.scenario: Károly is tired after a hard week and says he wants to give up the Hungarian course. You (Meg) say that, after all, you did not study so much just to give up now, and that, as you both know, the course is very important.
b1-36-01.prompt: Tell Károly why giving up now makes no sense and remind him that the course is important.
cues: Say why giving up now makes no sense
Add that this is very important, as you both know
b1-36-01.target: Elvégre nem azért tanultunk annyit, hogy most feladjuk. Ez ugyebár nagyon fontos.
b1-36-01.english: After all, we didn't study so much just to give up now. This is, as you know, very important.
b1-36-01.canDo: I can use conversational discourse particles like ugyebár and elvégre.

b1-36-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Tuesday, or Rather Wednesday
b1-36-02.scenario: Károly asks Meg which day the meeting was. You (Meg) say that it was on Tuesday, and then correct yourself: it was on Wednesday.
b1-36-02.prompt: Tell Károly which day the meeting was and correct yourself.
cues: Say which day the meeting was
Correct yourself and give the right day
b1-36-02.target: A megbeszélés kedden volt, vagyis inkább szerdán.
b1-36-02.english: The meeting was on Tuesday, or rather on Wednesday.
b1-36-02.canDo: I can self-correct naturally during speech using vagyis inkább and pontosabban.

b1-36-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Did I Understand You?
b1-36-03.scenario: Károly tells Meg that the time of the meeting has changed, but you are not sure you understood him. You (Meg) check politely: if you understood correctly, he is saying that the meeting is tomorrow, and you add that you are afraid you misunderstood each other about the time.
b1-36-03.prompt: Check politely what Károly said and say that you may have misunderstood each other.
cues: Check what you understood with ha jól értem
Say politely that you may have misunderstood each other about the time
b1-36-03.target: Ha jól értem, azt mondod, hogy a megbeszélés holnap van. Attól tartok, hogy félreértettük egymást az időpontot illetően.
b1-36-03.english: If I understand correctly, you're saying that the meeting is tomorrow. I'm afraid that we misunderstood each other regarding the time.
b1-36-03.canDo: I can resolve communication misunderstandings politely using ha jól értem.

b1-36-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Take a Seat, Please
b1-36-04.scenario: At a work event, an older guest whom Meg has just met comes to her table. You (Meg) politely ask the guest to take a seat, and then offer to use te with each other if the guest does not mind.
b1-36-04.prompt: Invite the guest to sit down politely and offer to use te.
cues: Ask the guest politely to take a seat
Offer to use te with each other
b1-36-04.target: Kérem, foglaljon helyet! Tegeződhetünk, ha nem bánja.
b1-36-04.english: Please, take a seat! We can address each other informally, if you don't mind.
b1-36-04.canDo: I can switch appropriately between formal (Ön) and informal (te) registers.

b1-36-05.title: Communicative Challenge: On My Own in Hungarian
b1-36-05.scenario: Károly asks Meg how she is getting on with Hungarian now. You (Meg) say that you are now able to handle every official matter on your own and that you can explain Hungarian history in your own words too.
b1-36-05.prompt: Tell Károly what you can now do on your own in Hungarian.
cues: Say what official matters you can handle on your own
Say that you can explain Hungarian history in your own words
b1-36-05.target: Most már képes vagyok önállóan elintézni minden hivatalos ügyet. Saját szavaimmal is el tudom magyarázni a magyar történelmet.
b1-36-05.english: I am now capable of handling every official matter independently. I can explain Hungarian history in my own words too.
b1-36-05.canDo: I can say that I can manage on my own in Hungarian.

b1-36-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Strength of the Walls
b1-36-consolidation.scenario: Petra asks Meg what happens at Eger Castle in Gárdonyi's story. You (Meg) say that Dobó István says the strength of the wall is in the people, and that in the end the people defeat the Turkish army.
b1-36-consolidation.prompt: Tell Petra what Dobó István says and how the story ends.
cues: Say what Dobó István says about the strength of the wall
Say what the people do to the Turkish army
b1-36-consolidation.target: Dobó István azt mondta, hogy a fal ereje az emberekben van. Az emberek legyőzték a török sereget.
b1-36-consolidation.english: Dobó István said that the strength of the wall is in the people. The people defeated the Turkish army.
b1-36-consolidation.canDo: I can retell in a few sentences what happens at Eger Castle in the story.
